name: forge-agent
description: An editor-native coding agent whose agent loop runs on TrueForge — built by THE AGENTIC ORDER for the TrueFoundry Forge-a-thon (Techfest 2026-27, IIT Bombay).

commands.title: Forge Agent: Open Session in TrueForge
Forge Agent: Revert Last Agent Change

forgeAgent.trueforgeUrl.description: Base URL of the local TrueForge server (npx @truefoundry/trueforge).

forgeAgent.model.description: Model as `<provider>/<model>` configured in TrueForge (e.g. nvidia/nemotron-3-5-super). Empty = the model in the agent definition.

forgeAgent.fallbackModels.description: Models (`<provider>/<model>` configured in TrueForge) that take over automatically, in order, when the current model fails (invalid key, unreachable endpoint, rate limit after one retry). Use a different provider than the primary model.

forgeAgent.agentDefinition.description: Path to an agent definition JSON. Empty = the bundled agent/forge-agent.json.

forgeAgent.contextBudgetTokens.description: Token budget of retrieve_context: how much ranked code the agent receives per retrieval.

forgeAgent.autoContextTokens.description: Token budget of the context the editor retrieves automatically for each chat message (0 = off).

forgeAgent.mentionBudgetTokens.description: Token budget for files and symbols attached with @-mentions (@path/to/file.py, @function_name).

forgeAgent.inlineAgentDefinition.description: Path to the agent definition JSON used for inline edits. Empty = the bundled agent/inline-edit.json.

forgeAgent.mcpServerName.description: Name under which the extension's editor MCP server is registered in TrueForge.

scripts.test: esbuild src/review/diff.test.ts src/review/edits.test.ts src/context/rank.test.ts src/mcp/checkOnly.test.ts src/agent/doneCheck.test.ts src/agent/fallback.test.ts src/agent/kickoff.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outdir=dist/test --entry-names=[name] --log-level=warning && node --test dist/test/diff.test.js dist/test/edits.test.js dist/test/rank.test.js dist/test/checkOnly.test.js dist/test/doneCheck.test.js dist/test/fallback.test.js dist/test/kickoff.test.js
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run compile && npm test
